about: The OptiScaler builds a package may carry and what the catalogue knows about them: the pinned commit (the fork build every package ships), the upstream commit backports are checked against, the commits whose INI keys and quirk effects match the pinned one, each build's DLL and OptiScaler.ini digests, the INI keys each OptiScaler.ini defines (once per digest), and the quirk tables of the pinned build.

quirks.about: Derived with the research quirks2.py from OptiScaler 03db4f86 (pinned at the time) and upstream 08e13adf; 25db192b and 273e8d44 add only code-level quirks (HideFsr4, ExtendedSearch), so these config-level tables are unchanged. titles: the game an upstream quirk entry names (its first comment line, normalized), which links an exe to its wiki title.
